verdict.rationale: Square documents a dedicated Sandbox environment (Square Sandbox overview, Sandbox Payments) and a specific "Test in the Sandbox" page for the Disputes API, which covers dispute-scenario testing. API Explorer also lets developers send requests against real Sandbox resources, and API Logs plus webhook event logs support debugging the flow. Most of this evidence is page titles or short excerpts rather than detailed content. missing for 10: explicit evidence of test card numbers for decline and error scenarios, detail on how closely the sandbox mirrors production, independent or hands-on corroboration of sandbox fidelity.
